description: Set your messaging username, interests, paid-inbox fee and search visibility. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

my_inbox_fee.description: Amount in GEODE as a decimal string (e.g. "1.25"), or {"raw": "<planck>"}

my_interests.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

my_username.description: UTF-8 text, at most 512 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_messaging_update_settings
title: Messaging: update settings
